text: @geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin 是一个供 DSH 使用的 Cordis 示例插件，通过 bundle patch 将插件加入选定 profile，并在 profile 启动、Cordis 调用 apply 时向控制台打印固定的“Hello World!”。它展示了最小插件入口和启动时执行逻辑，适合验证 DSH 插件加载流程或作为 hello world 入门示例；代码没有注册工具、命令或界面，也没有额外 API 密钥、账号或外部服务要求。安装时将 bundle 添加到 DSH profile，重启后启动该 profile 即可观察输出。

@geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin is a minimal Cordis plugin for DSH. A bundle patch adds it to a profile; on startup, apply() prints “Hello World!” to the console. It demonstrates plugin loading, registers no tools or UI, and needs no API key or external service.
想找一个最简单的 DSH 插件示例，在 profile 启动时向控制台输出一行文字。
I need a minimal DSH plugin example that prints a message when a profile starts.
@geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin 的功能「启动问候」：DSH profile 启动并由 Cordis 应用插件时，插件的 apply 入口会向控制台输出固定文本 Hello World!；无需用户输入或额外配置。

@geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin README · @geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin)

A minimal hello-world plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness. When a profile starts, the plugin prints `Hello World!` to the console.

@geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin README · Requirements：- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- DeepSeek Harness with `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `^4.0.2`

@geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin README · Install：Add the bundle to a DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin
```

Restart the profile after installation, then launch it:

```sh
dsh --profile <name>
```

The profile prints the following line when Cordis applies the plugin:

```text
Hello World!
```

Remove the bundle with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove @geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin
```

@geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin README · How it works：The package declares `cordis.patch.yml` as a DSH bundle patch. Installing the package adds that patch to the selected profile, and the patch inserts this package as a Cordis plugin. Cordis imports the compiled entry point and calls its exported `apply()` function during profile startup.

@geecraft23/dsh-hello-plugin README · Development：Install dependencies and verify the package:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run build
pnpm pack --dry-run

The published package contains the compiled JavaScript, TypeScript declarations, and `cordis.patch.yml`.
